method: Each full-library profile publishes fresh checks; benchmark outputs audited and reset between profiles. Reset/audit control traffic excluded. Sequential actions; deterministic mixed-order repetitions, counts recorded per comparison; identical per-recording canonical results and independent full-catalogue rectangle oracle. Compute from execution logs, not observer wall time or peak RSS. Descendant function counters exclude driver polling/start mutation and future lease-check calls. All dollar figures model US Starter marginal usage before allowances, exclude file I/O, storage and other system costs.
